### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The patient with chronic plaque psoriasis who has not responded well to traditional treatments may benefit from biologic therapy. Among the options, Ustekinumab is approved for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis and is likely indicated for this patient. Abatacept is approved for rheumatoid arthritis and is unlikely to be indicated. Leflunomide and Tocilizumab are not typically used for psoriasis and are also unlikely to be indicated.
